note: global header -- renders the platform's fixed logo, navigation, search control, sign-in/sign-up controls, skip link, and appearance settings
repository action controls -- renders fixed watch, fork, star, funding, and related controls with deterministic counters
repository navigation -- renders the fixed Code/Issues/Pull requests/Discussions/Actions/Security and quality/Insights tab vocabulary
issues search control -- renders the platform's fixed search interface
issue view navigation -- renders the fixed Issues and Pull requests view controls with deterministic counts
primary issue action -- renders the platform-defined create control
issue state controls -- renders the fixed open and closed issue view vocabulary
issue sorting control -- renders the platform-defined sort vocabulary
screen-reader section headings -- renders fixed platform accessibility labels
